title: ABFS generation and production threshold for auxiliary-basis screening

exx_pca_threshold.meaning: Threshold that screens on-site auxiliary functions (ABFS) in exact exchange; smaller values keep more auxiliary functions and enlarge the auxiliary basis.

abfs_generation.note: Generation run with rpa 1: controls how many auxiliary functions the product-PCA produces.

production.note: Formal GW/RPA run with ABFS_ORBITAL in STRU: values greater than 1 screen the PCA-generated auxiliary functions out, so only the prebuilt ABFS is used.

adjust.symptom: LRI error stays large at the GW level after the fullcoul check is clean
adjust.effect: regenerate the ABFS with a smaller generation-stage threshold so the auxiliary basis gets larger
adjust.guard: an oversized auxiliary basis becomes linearly dependent and makes the result worse; check the retained rank and near-null Coulomb directions before accepting it

adjust.symptom: bands are wrong while ABFS_ORBITAL is declared
adjust.effect: keep the production stage at exx_pca_threshold = 10 so two auxiliary-basis definitions are not stacked
adjust.guard: do not lower the production value below 1 to add PCA functions on top of a prebuilt ABFS

constraints: ABFS_ORBITAL and an active PCA threshold are two competing auxiliary-basis definitions.
With ABFS_ORBITAL set, exx_pca_threshold = 10 together with use_shrink_abfs = t is the production contract.
When a prebuilt database ABFS is staged through ABFS_ORBITAL, the production input still sets exx_pca_threshold = 10 and use_shrink_abfs = t.
Without ABFS_ORBITAL, the PCA generation route uses 1e-4 by default.
